title: Rosetta Stone carved
place: Egypt (probably a temple at Sais; found at Rashid)
summary: A decree for King Ptolemy V was carved in hieroglyphic, Demotic and Greek.
why: The parallel texts were the key to deciphering Egyptian scripts.

notes.problem: Wrong place for 'carved': source says it was 'almost certainly not originally placed at Rashid (Rosetta) where it was found', possibly from Sais.
